Machine Learning Engineer — Anthropic

Location: San Francisco, CA / Remote
Seniority: New Grad or 0-2 years

About the role:
Join our applied ML team building evaluation pipelines, fine-tuning workflows, and
inference tooling for large language models. You will work with PyTorch, experiment
tracking, and production serving paths.

Requirements:
- Python proficiency and comfort with numerical computing
- Coursework or project experience in machine learning
- Familiarity with PyTorch or JAX
- Ability to read papers and turn ideas into measurable experiments

Preferred:
- Experience with LLM fine-tuning, RLHF, or eval harnesses
- Distributed training or GPU optimization exposure
- Strong software engineering habits (tests, code review)

Domain: machine learning, AI infrastructure, evaluation
